test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the census 2011, which state is the most populous state in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A census is an official count of the population done periodically. In India, the first census was held in the year 1872. However, the first complete census was taken in the year 1881.
 
• In March 2011, India's population was 1,210.6 million, 17.5% of the world's population.
 
• The population of 1.21 billion people are unevenly distributed over the country.
 
• According to the data from the census 2011, Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state of India.
 
• UP has 16% of the country's population.
 
• From the above, it is clear that Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state of India according to the 2011 Census.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Sikkim has a population of just about 0.6 million and Lakshadweep has only 64,429 people.
 
• Half of India's population lives in these five states of India:
 
 
• UP, Maharashtra, Bihar, West-Bengal and Andhra Pradesh
 
 
 
• Regarding area, Rajasthan is the biggest state with only 5.5% of the total population of India.
